domain: Enterprise Data Analytics & Lookup Master Engine

users.purpose: Master user repository containing account profiles, business roles, and wallet balances for retailers, distributors, dealers, companies, employees, and admins.

columns.name: Full name or business account name of the user
columns.mobile_number: User phone or mobile contact number
columns.user_role: Integer code defining user tier and business entity type (1: Admin, 2: Distributor, 3: Dealer, 4: Company, 5: Retailer, 6: Employee)
columns.wallet_balance: Current available wallet credit balance in currency units
columns.status: User account status (0: Pending, 1: Active, 2: Rejected, 3: Suspended)

wallet_transaction.purpose: Audit ledger recording every credit, debit, QR scan reward, topup, withdrawal, and point movement for user wallets.

columns.amount: Transaction credit or debit monetary amount
columns.transaction_type: Transaction direction (1: Credit / Addition, 2: Debit / Deduction)
columns.reference_id: External reference object ID (e.g. invoice, scan, payout ID)
columns.reference_type: Source of transaction (scan_reward, topup, cash_point, withdrawal, bonus, transfer)
columns.status: Transaction state (0: Pending, 1: Completed / Success, 2: Failed, 3: Cancelled)

withdrawal_request.purpose: Cashout and payout requests submitted by users to transfer wallet balance into bank accounts.

columns.bank_transaction_id: Reference ID for external bank transaction
columns.status: Payout request state (0: Pending, 1: Approved / Completed, 2: Rejected, 3: Cancelled)
columns.tds_amount: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) withheld amount

companies.purpose: Company entity profiles, business units, phone records, and SAP enterprise integration codes.

sku_inventories.purpose: Product catalog and inventory stock records detailing SKU codes, MRPs, unit prices, and distributor allocations.

columns.distributer_id: Foreign key joining to users.id for distributor ownership

machine_details.purpose: Equipment assets, physical machine details, specifications, and hardware status.

columns.machine_name: Machine hardware model or asset name
columns.status: Operational state of machine (0: Inactive, 1: Active, 2: Maintenance)

automatic_transactions.purpose: Automated electronic bank fund transfers, direct account payouts, and bank reference logs.

columns.transfer_type: Payment transfer channel (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI)

automate.purpose: Background automated rules, trigger schedules, and system jobs.
